title: Fundación ATC Delivers Renovated Library to COBAT 18 in Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: The Fundación ATC, of the Asociación de Transportistas de Carga de Nuevo Laredo, delivered the renovated library at COBAT Plantel 18 on Tuesday, giving students a renewed space for reading and study, according to La Voz NLD.
content:
The Fundación ATC, of the Asociación de Transportistas de Carga de Nuevo Laredo, delivered the renovated library at the Colegio de Bachilleres del Estado de Tamaulipas (COBAT), Plantel 18, on Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to La Voz NLD.

The inauguration ceremony included the traditional ribbon cutting and brought together representatives of the school community and the transportation sector, according to the report.

Among those attending were Víctor Manuel González Salum, director general of the Colegios de Bachilleres del Estado de Tamaulipas; Yvette Bazán Múzquiz, president of Fundación ATC; and Edgar Orfelio Martínez Quintanilla, president of the Asociación de Transportistas de Carga de Nuevo Laredo, according to the report.

The library was remodeled to give students a proper place to consult materials, build a reading habit and strengthen their academic formation, according to the report. The COBAT director general recognized Fundación ATC's collaboration and stressed the importance of educational spaces that support the full development of young people.

The delivery reflects the participation of civil society organizations and the business sector in efforts to strengthen education in Nuevo Laredo, according to the report.

Sources: La Voz NLD, Nov. 17, 2026.
